name: 🍲 Soup & Sammie Night
tagline: Crispy, gooey turkey and cheddar melts dunked in hot soup: the coziest 20-minute dinner.

items.name: Soft butter (or mayo for extra crisp)
Pepper, a pinch of parmesan for the soup

steps.text: Warm the soup in a pot over medium-low, stirring now and then.
Butter one side of every bread slice.
Build: buttered side out, a slice of cheese, turkey, another slice of cheese.
Cook in a skillet over medium-low with a lid on, until golden and the cheese melts.
Cut into triangles or strips for dunking.
Ladle the soup and serve right away.

kid_jobs.job: Butter the bread to the edges
Cut dunkers with a butter knife

chef_tip: Medium-low heat and a lid. High heat burns the bread before the cheese melts; low and covered gets it golden and gooey.
make_ahead: Nothing to make ahead: this is the night you didn't plan.
leftovers: Soup keeps 3 days; sandwiches are best made fresh.
swaps: Whole Foods refrigerated soup (i394) for a step up
Deli ham or oven roasted turkey

game_plan.what: Soup in the pot on medium-low.
Kids butter the bread and build the sandwiches.
Sandwiches into the skillet, lid on.
Cut for dunking, ladle soup, eat right away.
